changeBrief: PR #16 introduces the semantic release pipeline and its hardened publication controls, then migrates SPDX 2.3 conformance to a hash-locked official spdx-tools environment followed by a repository-specific release contract. The latest changes add structural fail-closed regressions and complete the official invalid-document mutation matrix.

changeScope.evidence: 45 changed files and 5,543 insertions. Executable behavior spans four workflows, release configuration, a validation dependency lock, SPDX preparation and policy scripts, the repository validator, and two large mutation suites; the remainder is durable planning and review evidence.

pathCriticality.evidence: The diff controls GitHub App credentials, write-capable release tokens, protected tag creation, draft and immutable release mutation, third-party Actions, dependency installation, cross-job artifact transfer, checksum verification, and JSON/SBOM parsing.

history.evidence: Twenty-seven branch commits show repeated redesign and CCR remediation around workflow triggering, authentication, version synchronization, release ancestry, SPDX semantics, and structural fail-closed tests.

testPresence.evidence: The branch includes repository contract validation, negative workflow mutations, official SPDX subprocess mutations, local Python 3.9 and 3.12 runs, a checksummed real Syft chain, and hosted CI reporting 118 passed with no skips.

coverage.evidence: No line or branch coverage report is supplied, and the tag-to-draft-to-immutable release lifecycle cannot execute end to end until the workflow exists on main.

rollback.evidence: The branch can be reverted before release, but a published immutable release is intentionally difficult to reverse and a pre-publication failure can leave durable tag and draft-release state.

depthRationale: Human approved comprehensive depth because the change spans 45 files and critical release, credential, supply-chain, SBOM, artifact-transfer, and irreversible publication paths; line coverage and an end-to-end production release run are unavailable.
outOfScope: accessibility: no user interface or interactive end-user surface changed
